title: Drug Information Case 1 - Fungal Toe

interaction.urgency: ASAP because the patient may be discharged soon

doctor.name: Dr Anson Lo
doctor.opening: 藥劑師你好，我有位病人可能好快出院，佢有多隻腳趾甲真菌感染。我諗緊用 itraconazole，可唔可以幫我睇下應該點樣用？

medical_history: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, LVEF 35%
admission_problem: Fever, shortness of breath, wheezing and increasing sputum
Suspected pneumonia with right lower-zone haziness or possible collapse
medicines: Metformin 250 mg orally daily - hold during admission

toe_problem.prior_treatment: No previous oral or topical antifungal treatment
toe_problem.exhibit: Multiple yellow-brown, thickened and dystrophic toenails; the image alone does not establish microbiological diagnosis

reveal_only_when_asked: Extent and duration of the nail problem
Relevant chart details already available to the student
do_not_reveal: Rubric wording, grade caps or auto-fail rules
challenge_rules: If the student recommends topical treatment alone, ask whether it is adequate for the extent and likely adherence.
If the student proposes lowering atorvastatin, explain that high-intensity secondary prevention is important and ask for a safer antifungal plan.
After the main recommendation is complete, ask what carbamide is, what it does, and which strength is appropriate.

expected_clinical_answer: Avoid itraconazole because of heart failure and ventricular dysfunction.
Identify the clinically important itraconazole-atorvastatin interaction; the supplied rubric notes a maximum atorvastatin dose of 20 mg if co-administered.
Recommend terbinafine 125 mg orally once daily for 12 weeks under the supplied case teaching key, which applies a 50% dose reduction at creatinine clearance 20 to below 50 mL/min.
Topical therapy alone is not the expected first-line answer for this extensive presentation.
Carbamide is urea, acts as a keratolytic, and the expected strength is 40% cream.
YT 1.4-1.5 confirms terbinafine 125 mg once daily for 12 weeks as the required alternative in THIS renal case. Do not generalize this dose to other patients.
Diagnosis is already established by the doctor; no mandatory mycological confirmation is added (YT 1.3). Carbamide frequency/duration is optional enrichment (YT 1.6).

asr.context: CUHK pharmacy OSCE phone call. Preserve Cantonese-English code-switching, drug names, dose, duration, contraindication, interaction and negation exactly.

rubric.label: Identify Dr Anson Lo and resident-doctor role
Confirm urgency and construct the complete information need
Obtain relevant patient, disease, renal and medicine information
Use and communicate at least two drug-information sources
Recognise that itraconazole is unsuitable because of HFrEF
Recommend terbinafine as the systemic alternative
Give terbinafine 125 mg once daily for 12 weeks under the supplied teaching key
Provide an organised, professional answer within the station time

faculty_confirmation_required: Official numeric grade conversion, station time limit and faculty calibration samples.
Additional concrete auto-fail examples requested at the 23 September meeting.

faculty_clarifications.authority: Faculty PDF annotations take precedence over the earlier questions in its body; station-specific teaching conventions, not universal prescribing advice.

assessment_rules: English feedback, Cantonese dialogue and English drug names. Do not return student-assessed calculation results.
The numeric conversion is an Apricot AI proposal pending faculty calibration.
Clinical prompting is restricted to original rubric permissions, each at most once.
